answers.sql:
SELECT
  ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  SUM(f.TXN_CNT) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

WITH atm_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    br.BR_NM,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  WHERE d.DT_YR = 2025
  GROUP BY br.BR_NM
)
SELECT * FROM atm_2025 ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT MAX(d.dt) AS last_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.dt <= DATE '2025-08-31'
),
  defaults AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN last_day ld ON d.dt = ld.last_dt
    WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM defaults;

WITH complaints_2025 AS (
  SELECT c.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT c
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON c.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.DT_DT) = 2025
    AND ct.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM complaints_2025
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH august_max AS (
  SELECT MAX(DT_K) AS max_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DT_D) = 8
),
  august_dfts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
    JOIN august_max a ON d.BUS_DT_K = a.max_dt
    WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM august_dfts;

SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, DT_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT_DT) = 2025
), m AS (
  SELECT MKT_K, MKT_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.D_MKT
)
SELECT
  m.MKT_NM,
  SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
GROUP BY m.MKT_NM
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT
  ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
  COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND OPND_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY accounts_opened_2025 DESC;

SELECT
  b.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K AND b.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

answers.sql:
SELECT d_cmplt_ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d_cmplt_ctg
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d_cmplt_ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_cmplt_ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;

WITH fee_2025 AS (
  SELECT f.FEE_AMT,
         c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT channel_name,
       SUM(FEE_AMT) AS total_fee_amount
FROM fee_2025
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY total_fee_amount DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD';

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE j.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_severity_alerts_2025 DESC;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN target_date td ON f.BUS_DT_K = td.DT_K
WHERE f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR,
         SUM(f.TXN_CNT) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.DSC ILIKE '%mobile app%'
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       txn_count
FROM txn
ORDER BY CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
  SUM(b.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D b
JOIN target_date d ON b.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON b.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE p.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

WITH wr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.DT_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
), cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
    AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_sme_crossborder_customers
FROM wr
JOIN cust USING (CUST_K);

WITH atm_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d_br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
    d_br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.DT_K BETWEEN (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE DT = '2025-01-01')
                    AND (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE DT = '2025-12-31')
    AND d_br.IS_CURR = true
    AND d_br.IS_ACTV = true
  GROUP BY d_br.RGN_CD1, d_br.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM atm_counts
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, atm_txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

  SELECT f.AMT, f.ORGNL_AMT, f.MRCH_K, d.CAL_DT

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT) = 2025
), c AS (
  SELECT CCY_K, CCY_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CCY
)
SELECT c.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
GROUP BY c.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT
  ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN tx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON tx.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON tx.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT d_jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

WITH atm_counts AS (
  SELECT
    br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.DT_K BETWEEN (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE DT = '2025-01-01')
        AND (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE DT = '2025-12-31')
  GROUP BY br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT * FROM atm_counts ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT MAX(d.DT_K) AS dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND d.MTH_NBR = 8
    AND d.IS_MTH_END
), defaults AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
  JOIN last_day ld ON f.BUS_DT_K = ld.dt_k
  WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM defaults;

WITH complaints_2025 AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.BUS_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM complaints_2025 cmt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON cmt.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH august_last AS (
  SELECT MAX(bus_dt_k) AS last_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.dt_k = F_LN_DLQ_D.bus_dt_k
  WHERE d.dt BETWEEN '2023-08-01' AND '2023-08-31'
),
  defaults AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cust_k
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
    JOIN august_last a ON d.bus_dt_k = a.last_dt
    WHERE d.dflt_flg = TRUE
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM defaults;

SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, DT_YR, DT_MO, DT_DD
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
),
  v AS (
    SELECT f.MKT_K, f.MKT_VAL1_AMT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
    JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.DT_YR = 2025
  )
SELECT m.MKT_ID, m.MKT_NM, SUM(v.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM v
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON v.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
GROUP BY m.MKT_ID, m.MKT_NM
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT
  ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
  COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND OPND_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH atm_q1 AS (
  SELECT a.BR_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND d.QTR_NBR = 1
)
SELECT b.CTY_NM AS city,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_transactions
FROM atm_q1 aq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON aq.BR_K = b.BR_K
GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transactions DESC;

SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
